name: Verba
description: Retrieval-augmented generation chat interface backed by the Weaviate vector database.

envVars.description: API key for the OpenAI models used for generation

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      WEAVIATE_URL_VERBA: "http://{{serviceName}}-weaviate:8080"
      OPENAI_API_KEY: {{env.OPENAI_API_KEY}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data
  {{serviceName}}-weaviate:
    image: cr.weaviate.io/semitechnologies/weaviate:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-weaviate
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      QUERY_DEFAULTS_LIMIT: 25
      PERSISTENCE_DATA_PATH: /var/lib/weaviate
      DEFAULT_VECTORIZER_MODULE: none
